technique_name: Compare and contrast two characters from a book.
description: Harry Potter and Lord Voldemort are both powerful wizards in the Harry Potter series. While they have a lot of similarities – such as their powerful magical abilities, their thirst for power, and their ambition – they are also very different. Voldemort was born as Tom Riddle and had a difficult childhood full of loneliness, rejection and control issues, which led to him craving power to compensate for his past.
